lane: two-view co-training (Blum & Mitchell 1998, doi:10.1145/279943.279962); View A potential-field/subsurface, View B surface; disagreement as the discovery signal
hypothesis: the brief's disagreement field is only worth emitting at a support size set by the board's truth prevalence, not by the family's inherited 37,654-dot convention; the board budget follows from the instrument optimum divided by the measured prevalence ratio
mechanism: rank(A_post) - rank(B_post) over the whole footprint in a one-quadrant-per-fold out-of-fold mosaic, placed as 3 px dots outside the 200 m catalogue collar at the prevalence-corrected board budget
named_non_fault_process: basement lithological or intrusive contact under cover with no displacement; aeromagnetic flight-line/tie-line artefact in the supplied derivative bands; and for B-abstention-dominated dots, roads, canals and erosion lineaments

holdout_dti.shipped_rung: 75k2 (the instrument optimum of the shipped field)

bootstrap.caveat: Conditional on fitted folds, catalogue labels and fixed budgets; not a leaderboard interval.

holdout_dti.simulator_validity: R4 measured Spearman -0.10 between this instrument and the owner-reported board; it screens procedures and does not promote

prevalence_correction.reasoning: a budget tuned on a denser truth field is tuned too high; for a self-similar field the crossing where the marginal dot stops paying moves roughly in proportion to the density of truth, so the board budget is the instrument optimum divided by this ratio. This is a proportionality argument, not a measurement on the board, and it is reported with both ratios.

scores.provenance: owner-reported on the family site, not an organiser receipt

board_algebra.note: T is recovered from the score's own definition; it is a reconstruction from two owner-reported scores, not a measurement of any submission's internals.

support_calibration.caveat: a proportionality argument for a self-similar field, not a measurement on the board; every curve is still rising at the top rung, so the corrected budget is a LOWER bound

note: H88 co-train disagreement disagreement_post, prevalence-calibrated 17707px, 3px spacing, 200m collar

not_the_union.verdict: the emission is not max(A,B), not either single view, and not their union -- but it is dominated by the surface view's abstention: only 499 of 17707 dots sit in the strict A-only stratum

literal.note: applied to every aligned prior including universal-coverage probes

policy.note: the same literal rule restricted to priors that localise something; probe statistics are retained verbatim in per_prior and nothing is deleted

correlation_vs_registry.scope: 146 aligned rasters still on disk (submission/, docs/downloads/, data/scored/); the 545-raster work/h61/priors inventory used by the H61/H75 cards is no longer in the workspace

lane_rule: STOP at Spearman > 0.90 or directed <= 3 px dot proximity > 0.70; no lane retuning
canary_note: the per-feature leakage canary (AUC > 0.90 = leakage) is carried by the shared fit stage; the highest view AUC measured in this family is 0.9481 in-sample, which is not an alarm -- alarms are on held-out features
verdict: HOLDOUT: NEGATIVE -- the mandated disagreement field measures 0.0632 pooled HOLDOUT-DTI at 75.2k dots, below the random arm (0.1346) and 0.1596 below single_B with a paired CI excluding zero. LANE: DUPLICATE/STOP on dots (directed <=3 px proximity 1.0000 > 0.70; the largest offender is our own H61 candidate, which shares the same out-of-fold field family). Overall: research-only. DOWNLOAD YES (format-valid, decoded-unique), SUBMIT NO.
ai_use: An AI assistant wrote the code, the protocol and the reasoning templates. No geologist verified any emitted structure and no field observation was collected.
